entries.title: American University in Baghdad
entries.summary: This Iraqi university reference connects lobby seating and reception with the lecture-building circulation. The gallery includes project seating and the production of curved furniture components.
discussion: Provide the curved seating dimensions and drawings.
Identify access routes and reception clearances.
Review samples and component interfaces before ordering.

entries.title: Holiday Inn Fairview Heights
entries.summary: The documented guestroom at Holiday Inn Fairview Heights provides a reference for coordinating the bed, bedside storage and a compact seating area. Use the photograph to discuss layout and interfaces; dimensions, finishes and the scope of a new order require separate confirmation.
discussion: Provide a dimensioned room plan and the number of each room type.
Mark sockets, lighting positions and access for assembly.
Confirm finish samples and interfaces before approving the furniture schedule.
